chunks: And by his chain, he said: Rasool-Allah said:
Obedience to the woman is remorse.
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the consequence of obeying a woman?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise saying of the Prophet (peace be upon him) linking a wife's obedience to 'ndamah' (remorse or regret), highlighting the potential for loss of dignity or authority if a husband yields indiscriminately. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balanced marital dynamics where obedience is not absolute subservience but is contextualized within wisdom and mutual respect, warning against blind compliance that may lead to future regret.

en.hubeali: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Obeying the woman is remorse’.
en.sarwar: 4. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,
has said, ‘Obeying the woman brings regret.’”
